shortDescription: Manage IPSec policies on a BIG-IP

options.name: auth_algorithm
options.description: Specifies the algorithm to use for IKE authentication.

options.name: encrypt_algorithm
options.description: Specifies the algorithm to use for IKE encryption.

options.name: ipcomp
options.description: Specifies whether to use IPComp encapsulation. When C(none), specifies IPComp is disabled. When C(deflate), specifies IPComp is enabled and uses the Deflate compression algorithm.

options.name: ipv4_interface
options.description: When C(mode) is C(interface), indicates if the IPv4 C(any) address should be used. By default C(BIG-IP) assumes C(any6) address for tunnel addresses when C(mode) is C(interface). This option takes effect only when C(mode) is set to C(interface).

options.name: kb_lifetime
options.description: Specifies the length of time before the IKE security association, in kilobytes. expires.

options.name: lifetime
options.description: Specifies the length of time before the IKE security association expires, in minutes.

options.name: mode
options.description: Specifies the processing mode. When C(transport), specifies a mode that encapsulates only the payload (adding an ESP header, trailer, and authentication tag). When C(tunnel), specifies a mode that includes encapsulation of the header as well as the payload (adding a new IP header, in addition to adding an ESP header, trailer, and authentication tag). options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the IPSec policy.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: perfect_forward_secrecy
options.description: Specifies the Diffie-Hellman group to use for IKE Phase 2 negotiation.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Specifies the IPsec protocol. Options include ESP (Encapsulating Security Protocol) or AH (Authentication Header).

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: route_domain
options.description: Specifies the route domain, when C(interface) is selected for the C(mode) setting.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.

options.name: tunnel_local_address
options.description: Specifies the local endpoint IP address of the IPsec tunnel. This parameter is only valid when C(mode) is C(tunnel).

options.name: tunnel_remote_address
options.description: Specifies the remote endpoint IP address of the IPsec tunnel. This parameter is only valid when C(mode) is C(tunnel).
